method: Manual inspection of rendered PNGs with view_image, plus exported-geometry assertions for counts and dimensions

clock-tower.observation: Three distinct plinth tiers are visible.

clock-tower.feature: square mossy shaft with visible block courses
clock-tower.observation: Square block courses and moss patches read; recessed backing closes sky leaks in the shaft.

clock-tower.feature: round white 3.2 m face with two plain metal hands
clock-tower.observation: The white round face has exactly two visible plain geometry hands.
Four pitched roof faces meet the finial.

clock-tower.feature: winding side stair with stepped stone parapet
clock-tower.observation: Separate stair risers and the stepped parapet are readable at 40 m in the 50-degree-VFOV frame.

watchtower.feature: tapered drum with individual block courses
watchtower.observation: The full drum has broad solid flanks, a vertical lower section through the arch and a tapered upper section. Recessed mortar keeps the block courses continuous.

watchtower.feature: twelve crenellation slots with exactly three missing merlons
watchtower.observation: Nine merlons are present; the exported vertices leave exactly slots 1, 5 and 8 empty.

watchtower.feature: two recessed arched windows on opposite faces
watchtower.observation: An arched window is recessed above each mouth; both openings have dark backs and stone frames.

watchtower.feature: full-depth arched tunnel with a keystone at both mouths
watchtower.observation: The shallow elliptical through-arch has individually separated voussoirs, straight jamb stones and a central trapezoidal keystone at each mouth.

watchtower.feature: lower-third ivy and moss with jungle atlas and vertex tint
watchtower.observation: The green band wraps the curved structural drum and tunnel surfaces. Exported vertex colours vary across its height and around its circumference.

waterfall-cliff.feature: stacked mossy stone block cliff with ledges
waterfall-cliff.observation: Stacked masonry blocks and moss caps read; a recessed backing closes joint sky leaks.
A complete cyan foam ring is visible in the three-quarter frame.

waterfall-cliff.feature: two blossom clumps on the existing jungle-card sheet
waterfall-cliff.observation: Two separate blossom clumps use the existing keyed sprite.

waterfall-cliff.feature: projecting block ledges that cast distinct shadows
waterfall-cliff.observation: Ledges project in side view and cast clear shadows in the three-quarter view.
The overhanging lip is visible; the named anchor measures Y=16 over the pool datum Y=0.

sea-stack-set.observation: All four tapered silhouettes are visible together from front/back/three-quarter.
All four moss caps are visible in the three-quarter view.

sea-stack-set.feature: one natural through-arch in the 32 m stack
sea-stack-set.observation: The 32 m stack has a visible through-arch in front and back.
The short buttress, needle, arch and overhanging tall profiles differ in lean and outline.

sea-stack-set.feature: distinct buttress, needle, arch and overhanging tall silhouettes
sea-stack-set.observation: All four profiles remain separated and distinguishable against the sky at 300 m / 50-degree VFOV.

limitations: Standalone authored lighting and camera; full-game lighting/fog/performance remain unverified until integration.
The set is staged along X, so the strict side view occludes smaller sea stacks; front/back/three-quarter and 300 m frames show all four.
